description: Media players select media by its Port OS media ID, play supplied audio or a URI, and control playback. Read playback state and use only the commands supported by the connected player.

supportedMediaResources.description: Exact play-media URI combinations accepted by this route. Member or endpoint unions do not imply support by every route.

items.title: SupportedMediaResource
items.description: A provider, media type and resource-kind combination accepted by a control route.
Lowercase resource-kind segment from the provider URI.

supportedAudioProviders.description: Audio services accepted by search-and-play on this endpoint. These describe command support, not active subscriptions.

items.description: Media service identifier. A provider enum value does not imply that every endpoint supports that service; use the endpoint's advertised provider lists.

supportedVideoProviders.description: Video services accepted by search-and-play on this endpoint. These describe command support, not installed applications or active subscriptions.

defaultAudioProvider.description: Default service for an audio search. Must be in supportedAudioProviders.

defaultVideoProvider.description: Default service for a video search. Must be in supportedVideoProviders.

maxPlaylistSize.description: Maximum number of items in a playlist

defaultQuality.description: Default quality setting for media playback

supportsPlayURI.description: Whether the endpoint can play an audio URI.

supportedAudioMimeTypes.description: Audio MIME types accepted by play-audio. Advertise play-audio only when audio output is supported.

title: MediaPlayerInterfaceConfiguration
